ORDINANCE XLIII OF 1984
CRIMINAL LAW (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the
Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 27th September, 1984.]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :--
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Criminal Law (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section 123-B, Act XLV of 1860

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XLIII OF 1984
CRIMINAL LAW (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the
Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 27th September, 1984.]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :--
2. Insertion of new section 123-B, Act XLV of 1860.--In Pakistan
Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), after section 123-A, the following new section
shall be inserted, namely :-
"123-B.
Defiling or unauthorisedly removing the National Flag of Pakistan from
Government building, etc.-Whoever deliberately defiles the National Flag of
Pakistan, or unauthorisedly removes it from any building, premises, vehicle or
other property of Government, shall be punished with imprisonment of either
description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with
both.".
